hero.subtitle: Maritime MRV platform with satellite AIS tracking, independent SAR validation, EU ETS/FuelEU calculation, and immutable SHA-256 chain of custody.

problem.label: The Problem
problem.lead: European regulators demand auditable MRV. Shippers demand traceable Scope 3. Ports need data for green corridor access. The market no longer accepts PDFs.
problem.p2_title: Manual and unaudited EU ETS calculation

portals.label: 5 Dedicated Portals
portals.title: One system, five business perspectives
portals.lead: Each stakeholder sees exactly what they need. The same traceable evidence, presented in the correct context.
portals.p1_desc: Fleet, EU ETS emissions, FuelEU compliance, Green Corridors, and Evidence Vault in a unified interface.
portals.p2_desc: CO₂ per booking, Scope 3 Cat. 4 attribution, ISO 14083 Green Certificate, and booking traceability.
portals.p3_desc: Real-time traffic monitor, active geofence, vessel ranking by EEOI, and declared emissions.
portals.p4_desc: Read-only Evidence Vault with SHA-256 logs, audit trail, and EU MRV export.
portals.p5_desc: Verified, public voyage page without login. Anti-greenwashing. QR code for supply chains.

data.label: Data Sources
data.title: Hierarchy of evidence, not inference
data.lead: Official API first. Observed data before declared data. AI model as interpreter, never as a source.
data.disclaimer: The architecture explicitly distinguishes: LIVE · DEMO · STALE · UNAVAILABLE. No LLM inference replaces verified data.
data.s2_desc: Independent position validation via orbital radar
data.s5_desc: Interpretation, summarization, and analysis — server-side only

ai.lead: The Blink AI Gateway connects the backend to over 200 language models. All calls are server-side. The API key never reaches the browser. Outputs are always marked as MODEL_OPINION.
ai.f1_desc: EU MRV / FuelEU / EU ETS in operational language
ai.f2_desc: Explanation for position or emission deviations

evidence.label: Evidence Vault
evidence.title: Every declaration has a proof.
evidence.lead: Immutable SHA-256. Registered parser version. AIS observations counted. SAR validations documented. No blank fields.

compliance.label: Compliance
compliance.title: Built on real regulatory frameworks
compliance.lead: No invented regulatory references. All standards are traceable to the official text published by the European Commission, IMO, and ISO.
compliance.disclaimer: Meridian Intelligence is isolated from the MeridianMRV Core. Data is promoted via human review flow. The system never writes directly to the core.

cta.title: Prove what you declare.
cta.lead: Access the five portals, explore the Evidence Vault, and see the complete maritime intelligence chain in action.
